LBY.note: SMS voter-registration check is not an ID authentication service.
Document does not mention civil register or ID links.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.

facts.fact: The High National Elections Commission (HNEC) says voters check their registration, and register in the voter register, by SMS to 17017 using their National Number and polling-centre number.

LBY.note: Document names a National Number but states nothing on the ID system itself.
